setup:
@c1 command action=create shape=rectangle name=Plot color=brown fill=none width=500 height=320 position=center
@c2 command action=create shape=text name=Heading label="Plot 18" position=top
text: Gate in the bottom edge, near the right.

wires.span: Gate in the bottom edge, near the right

adjudicated.why: A clear verbless create, and 'in X' on a create is inside; B leaves out a clear request.

text: Path straight up from there.

wires.span: Path straight up from there

adjudicated.why: A clear verbless create; 'there' is the gate from the earlier unnamed step, reached by a mention.

text: Shed top left. About a quarter of that width.

wires.span: Shed top left. About a quarter of that width

adjudicated.why: A clear create at the canvas place topLeft, with width in pixels as a quarter of the plot's 500.

text: Water butt beside it, little blue one.

wires.span: Water butt beside it, little blue one

adjudicated.why: A clear create near the shed; 'it' is the shed from the earlier unnamed step, reached by a mention.

text: Two long beds to the left of the path.

wires.span: Two long beds to the left of the path

adjudicated.why: A clear create with count 2 left of the path, which is reached by a mention.

text: Upper one Potatoes, lower one Beans.
Leave walking room between those.
A smaller bed opposite the beans. Strawberries.

wires.span: A smaller bed opposite the beans. Strawberries

adjudicated.why: A clear create labelled Strawberries; 'opposite' has no legend position, so it is left out.

text: Pink for that, so I can spot it.

wires.span: Pink for that

adjudicated.why: 'that' is the strawberry bed from the earlier unnamed step, reached by a mention; the rest is a reason.

text: Compost up in the spare corner on the right.

wires.span: Compost up in the spare corner on the right

adjudicated.why: A clear create; 'up ... in the corner on the right' is the canvas place topRight.

text: Actually two bins there, side by side.

wires.span: two bins there, side by side

adjudicated.why: A self-correction gives the final wish: two compost bins, made by duplicating the existing one.

text: One says Filling, the other Ready.

wires.span: One says Filling
the other Ready

adjudicated.why: Verb ellipsis gives each label its own wire, and 'one ... the other' needs two distinct bins, so they are told apart by recency.

text: Can't read Ready against that brown. White writing please.
Same for Filling.
How much empty space is there above the strawberries?
Try a little greenhouse in that gap.

wires.span: Try a little greenhouse in that gap

adjudicated.why: A clear create; 'that gap' is the space above the strawberries named in the earlier question.

text: Bit smaller. I still need to get round it with the barrow.

wires.span: Bit smaller

adjudicated.why: Size words: 'a bit smaller' is resize scale 0.8, on the greenhouse just made.

setup:
@c1 command action=create shape=rectangle name=Tank color=blue fill=light width=560 height=340 position=center
@c2 command action=create shape=rectangle name=Sand color=yellow width=560 height=40 position=bottom
text: sand needs to be inside the tank at the bottom

wires.span: sand needs to be inside the tank at the bottom

text: i want a goldfish in the middle

wires.span: i want a goldfish in the middle

adjudicated.why: A clear create at the canvas place center; goldfish is not a legend object or shape.

text: orange with a big tail

wires.span: orange

adjudicated.why: With no earlier words, the target is the shape last made, an unnamed session create, so mention(recency=newest); 'a big tail' cannot be expressed.

text: give him an eye too

wires.span: give him an eye

adjudicated.why: Eye is a legend object, so this is a create with object=eye.

text: his names Pickle write it under him

wires.span: his names Pickle
write it under him

adjudicated.why: One wire per request: Pickle is a one-word name given to the orange fish, and 'write X under A' is free text below it.

text: some bubbles coming from his mouth

wires.span: some bubbles coming from his mouth

adjudicated.why: A clear create near Pickle; 'his mouth' is not a drawn shape.

text: upwards like hes breathing

wires.span: upwards

adjudicated.why: A move's trigger is its direction words, and the bubbles (one unnamed shape, mention(recency=newest)) are moved up with no distance; arranging a single shape does nothing, and 'like hes breathing' is a reason.

text: green weed over on the left in the sand

wires.span: green weed over on the left in the sand

adjudicated.why: A clear create, and 'in X' on a create is inside Sand.

text: taller than Pickle

wires.span: taller than Pickle

adjudicated.why: Relative size is resize with no scale (it grows), on the weed just made, which is the only green shape.

text: a rock at the other end

wires.span: a rock at the other end

adjudicated.why: A clear create; the other end from the left-hand weed is the canvas place right.

text: thats massive he cant swim past it!! make it littler

wires.span: make it littler

adjudicated.why: A complaint gives the wish inside it; 'littler' is smaller, resize scale 0.67, and 'it' is the rock just made.

text: tiny snail on top of the rock

wires.span: tiny snail on top of the rock

adjudicated.why: 'On top of X' on a create is onTop, and the rock is the newest unnamed shape.

text: purple shell :)

wires.span: purple shell

adjudicated.why: A fragment with a clear wish: colour the snail just made purple.

text: can he have a friend near the weed

wires.span: have a friend near the weed

adjudicated.why: A clear create near the weed, which the mention picks exactly.

text: a blue fish no yellow actually

wires.span: a blue fish no yellow actually

adjudicated.why: A self-correction keeps only the final wish: the new fish becomes yellow.

text: that ones Noodle

wires.span: that ones Noodle

adjudicated.why: Noodle is a one-word name given to the newest fish.

text: put both names above them instead theyre down in the sand

wires.span: put both names above them instead

adjudicated.why: Only Pickle's name text is on the drawing; Noodle's written name is a reference to nothing, so only the Pickle text moves above Pickle.

setup:
@c1 command action=create shape=rectangle name=Front color=yellow width=480 height=360 position=center
@c2 command action=create shape=rectangle name=Opening color=black width=300 height=180 position=inside anchor=Front
text: Red curtains either side of the opening, please.

wires.span: Red curtains either side of the opening

adjudicated.why: A clear wish for two red shapes beside the drawn Opening is expressible as a create (shape is optional, only stated values), so it is not a no-wire case.

text: Pulled back a little. We need to see the puppets.
A red bit across the top too.

wires.span: A red bit across the top

adjudicated.why: "the top" is a canvas place noun with no named anchor, and args hold only what the message expresses, so create color=red position=top.

text: Above that, write Alfie's Theatre.

wires.span: Above that, write Alfie's Theatre

adjudicated.why: "write X above A" is a free-text create, and "that" is the red bit from an unnamed session create, so it is a mention.

text: Bigger letters. He'll want to read his name from the sofa.

wires.span: Bigger letters

adjudicated.why: "bigger" is resize with no scale, and the unnamed session text is reached by its words with shape=text.

text: Little gold stars by the name, one each side.

wires.span: Little gold stars by the name, one each side

adjudicated.why: A stated create of 2 small gold stars near the name text, which is reached by its words as a mention.

text: Now a shelf along the bottom of the opening.

wires.span: a shelf along the bottom of the opening

adjudicated.why: A clear create placed at the named Opening is expressible (no shape stated, so none), so it is not a no-wire case.

text: Brown, like the bit of wood I'll use.

wires.span: Brown

adjudicated.why: With no words for the target, it is the shape last made (the unnamed shelf), written mention(recency=newest).

text: Underneath, a sign saying Next show: 3 o'clock.

wires.span: Underneath, a sign saying Next show: 3 o'clock

adjudicated.why: A bare "Underneath" elides its object, so by the pronoun rule the anchor is the shape last made or changed (the unnamed shelf), not an invented Front.

text: Give the sign a white background.

wires.span: Give the sign a white background

adjudicated.why: The unnamed session sign is reached by its words, and a background colour is set color=white.

text: Blue round the outside. The sign, I mean, not the whole theatre.

wires.span: Blue round the outside

adjudicated.why: A self-correction keeps the final wish: a blue outline on the sign, reached by its words.

text: A tiny ticket window down on the left.

wires.span: A tiny ticket window down on the left

text: Tickets over that. 10p below it.

wires.span: Tickets over that
10p below it

text: Could the show time go a little to the right? Crowded now.

wires.span: Could the show time go a little to the right

adjudicated.why: Moves: "a little" gives distance=20, and the show-time sign is written as what it is on the drawing (a label mention).

text: Actually take the price off. His sister will insist on real money.

wires.span: take the price off

text: Last thing, a smiling sun in that empty bottom right corner.

wires.span: a smiling sun in that empty bottom right corner
